Morning Dolores! I'm just having a simple toast with some fruit. Care to join me?
Sure, I'd love to join you. Can I help with anything?
That would be great! Can you grab the orange juice from the fridge and pour us two glasses?
Sure thing! I'll grab that for us.
Thanks for helping out, Dolores. I really appreciate it.
No problem at all! I'll grab that right away.
While you're at it, could you also check if there's any yogurt left in the fridge? I think we might be running low.
Of course! Let me check on that yogurt for you.
Thanks, Dolores! I really appreciate your help. By the way, have you got any plans for later today? Maybe we could grab a coffee together after our shift ends.
Sounds like a plan! I'd love to grab a coffee with you after our shift. Let's catch up then!
That's great! I'm looking forward to it. Shall we meet at Hobbs Cafe after our shift ends?
Sure, Maeve! Let's meet at Hobbs Cafe after our shift ends. See you later!
Sounds perfect! I'll see you at Hobbs Cafe after our shift ends. Have a great day, Dolores!
